summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a profound lecture on the final chapter of a text regarding what Allah has prepared for believers in paradise. He emphasizes that paradise is within reach for all Muslims regardless of past sins, as believers will be judged based on their current state when they meet Allah. The core of his message centers on the greatest reward of paradise: the vision of Allah (Beatific Vision). Sh. Ali Mashhour shares the hadith of Jarir ibn Abdullah describing how believers will see Allah in paradise just as clearly as one sees the full moon, and emphasizes through the Prophet's dialogue that nothing in paradise—no matter how wondrous—compares to the bliss of seeing Allah's face.
suggested_title: The Greatest Blessing of Paradise: The Vision of Allah
